observations.text: Fireman's outfit lifeline instructions (1 pull, 2 pull, 3 pull) must be on a metal plate with metal wire; laminated or plastic instructions are not acceptable.
Warning signs required on bulkhead of forecastle near ladder on all three entrances (both sides and catwalk middle).

positives: Chief officer explained cargo hazards and precautions well; inspector was satisfied.
Bosun gave positive remarks on enclosed space entry knowledge.
style: Well versed with SIRE 2.0 and knows what to ask.
Very strict and gives many remarks.
Detailed and thorough in checking documents and equipment.

questions.q: What are the intervals of checks and duties in enclosed space?
What will happen if you close the valve in running cargo and what do you do during spill?
Why is there a delay in fire alarm at sea and why not in port?
What is the safe distance from any obstruction in open sea and in congested waters as per master's standing orders?
What is the use of full light lines? Show on ECDIS.
What are the procedures for two-person verification of passage plan?

checks.item: Ship shore safety checklist
Poster on gangway showing fire pump and fire plan
Alarm settings of cargo panel
Daily work plan meeting signatures
SIMOPS for SIRE inspection and discharging operation
Cargo plan and signatures
Risk assessment for mooring and use of tugs
Bell book entries for pre anchoring meeting, toolbox talk, pre mooring entries
ESD testing records and entries
Last cargo audits and inhibited cargo in those audits
Enclosed space permit and risk assessment
Gas detector alarms as per company SMS and on gas detectors
New CO2 requirements for enclosed space and procedures
Brake testing and calibration of winch gauge
Lifejacket and life vest, difference, when to check, records
ETA inspection records, tools and location
Mooring area and warning signs on forecastle bulkhead
Fireman's outfit lifeline instructions on metal plate with metal wire
Navigational dynamic and static audit reports
Risk assessment for cross checking obstruction near planned passage by two means
Echo sounder accuracy check records
Scamin settings
BWL for each leg of passage plan with engine room watch levels
Steering gear records prior leaving port
Fire rounds records

tips: Ensure fireman's outfit lifeline instructions are on metal plate with metal wire.
Post fire pump and fire plan on gangway.
Be prepared for detailed questions on enclosed space entry and cargo operations.
summary: Inspection by Pawel Razniewski (Polish) in Castellon, Spain. He boarded by boat and was very strict, well versed with SIRE 2.0. He raised observations on fireman's outfit lifeline instructions and warning signs on forecastle. The inspection date was not provided.
